coaching.headline: Three cross-map prizes and only one lost fight sealed a dominant 22-minute win, 6 towers to 0.
coaching.team: The lane sheet read unfavored early in the carry, offlane, and jungle matchups, and favored in mid and support, but first blood came to us at 2.6 when Khaimera caught Wraith. Kallari was caught out 1.3 minutes later. The game turned at 11.2: three of us won 4-1 at their Outer Tower while Murdock and Khaimera were elsewhere as we took the Mini Prime across the map - two prizes at once. We gave one back at 13.5, losing a contested Fangtooth fight 2-3 after Murdock's solo death at 12.8 and a second death from Sparrow inside the fight. From there it was one-sided: a 3-1 win at their Inhibitor at 19.7 put the game out of reach. The match-ending push through Fangtooth at 21.1 and 22.0 finished the game 6 towers to 0 in 22 minutes.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 11.2 fight flipped the game: three players won 4-1 at the Outer Tower while Murdock and Khaimera took the Mini Prime across the map, a two-for-one. The only step back was 13.5, where Murdock's solo death at 12.8 set up a Fangtooth loss 2-3 forty-five seconds later.
coaching.whatWorked: Splitting the map at 11.2 - three players won the fight 4-1 at the Outer Tower while Murdock and Khaimera took the Mini Prime, landing both prizes at once.

focus.title: A 5v4 that only traded
focus.evidence: At 18.2, with Mini Prime live, we had 5 players alive to their 4, yet the skirmish finished 1-1 instead of a clean win.
focus.action: Collapse a numbers advantage fully - focus one target down before trading, rather than settling for an even fight when outnumbering the enemy.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Our damage is 4/5 physical — predictable; the enemy itemizes one armor item against most of it. A magical pick would split their defenses.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

ourKits.combo: Shadow Walk stealth → Crippling Dagger slow → Shadow Dance gap-close → Guillotine execute ult
ourKits.winCondition: stealth-pick an isolated squishy and execute with Guillotine
ourKits.passive: Death Mark detonates for bonus burst
ourKits.playWith: a team that follows her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: ward/reveal for the stealth; she's the squishiest hero — any CC kills her

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
enemyKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

enemyKits.combo: Judgement tether → Surge knockup → Fury of the Heavens slow, recall the blade
enemyKits.winCondition: tether a target, knock up and brawl with energized basics
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he tethers and knocks up
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait his blade-recall mobility, then punish when it's placed

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
enemyKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
enemyKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe
